sheet_prompt:
One illustration of 9 separate characters arranged in 3 rows of 3, evenly spaced across a single seamless background.
Subject: A colorful round generic emoji face with simple eyes and mouth, identical in every cell.
Style: glossy 3D render, smooth rounded shapes, shiny plastic-like material, soft studio lighting with bright reflections.
Outline: none. Draw every character directly on the background with no outline, border, stroke, die-cut edge or halo around it.
Reading left to right, top to bottom, every character shows a different emotion on the same face: only the expression changes, so no two characters share the same eyes, eyebrows or mouth:
Character 1: Smiling brightly with wide open eyes and a big grin
Character 2: Eyes closed, blushing with a shy smile, tilting head slightly
Character 3: Frowning deeply with downward eyebrows and teardrops
Character 4: Eyes wide open, mouth round in shock, eyebrows raised
Character 5: Eyes narrowed with a mischievous grin, one eyebrow raised
Character 6: Angry scowl with furrowed brows and clenched teeth
Character 7: Yawning with eyes half closed and hand covering mouth
Character 8: Rolling eyes upwards with a bored flat mouth
Character 9: Loving eyes shaped like hearts, smiling warmly
Make every expression big and readable at small size: exaggerated eyes, eyebrows and mouth. Faces only: never a body, arms, hands, legs, feet, ears, tails or props.
Consistency: the same character design, proportions and colours for all 9 characters.
Background: a single, seamless, solid pure green (#00FF00) background covering the whole image in exactly one shade, with no tiled panels, no shading variations, no tint, gradient, vignette or glow, no shadows, no floor, no noise.
Spacing: every character is the face and head alone, large and centred, with a generous empty margin on every side (at least 20% of its own size), clearly separated from the others, none touching or crossing another.
video_prompt:
Animate this illustration sheet as a 3-second clip. Every face performs its own big, highly expressive, cartoon-style animation in place, inside its own cell, showing a wide range of emotions:
1. The emoji bounces gently up and down with a cheerful spring.
2. The emoji gently sways side to side with a bashful bounce.
3. The emoji quivers slightly with a slow trembling motion.
4. The emoji shakes side to side quickly like a startled jolt.
5. The emoji leans forward and back like plotting a playful trick.
6. The emoji pulses in size quickly like a furious heartbeat.
7. The emoji slowly rocks side to side like sleepy swaying.
8. The emoji rotates slowly in place showing disinterest.
9. The emoji pulses gently with heart shapes shimmering softly.
Animation style: wide emotions on highly expressive faces, exaggerated squash and stretch of the face, anticipation and follow-through, clear facial animation (eyes, eyebrows, mouth), each face on its own rhythm, lively and full of personality. Faces only: no bodies, no hands, no ears, no tails, no props. Never still and never only a gentle sway.
Keep every face inside its own slot of the 3x3 layout; nothing may touch or cross a slot edge, and faces never interact with one another.
Empty slots stay empty: do not add any character, object or effect to them.
Static camera, no zoom, no pan, no cuts. Keep the one flat pure green (#00FF00) background exactly as it is, the same shade everywhere: no shadows, no gradient, no noise, no glow.
Keep each face's design, proportions and colours unchanged and do not add outlines or borders.
